name: galtea-tracing
description: Send each Claude Code conversation to Galtea as a production session, with its model calls, tool calls and subagents as traces.

api_key.title: Galtea API key
api_key.description: Your gsk_ key from the Galtea dashboard, Settings > API Keys (an older gsk- key also works). Kept in Claude Code's secure storage.

product_id.title: Galtea product id
product_id.description: The product that receives your sessions. Copy its id from the product page in the Galtea dashboard.

api_url.title: Galtea API URL
api_url.description: Change it only for a self-hosted Galtea.

redact_secrets.title: Redact secrets
redact_secrets.description: Mask API keys, tokens, passwords and private keys before they leave your machine. Best-effort: it can miss a secret.
